primary_sources.locator: DOI 10.1073/pnas.151231598; Methods (constructs, in-vitro interaction, fractionation), Results/Figures 1–5 and Discussion; AF160973.1/AAD45723.1 deposited sequence.
primary_sources.read_scope: Complete cached abstract; author-uploaded original indexed lines 266–464 (Methods), 553–600, 655–828, 857–903, 924–959, 1068–1101 and 1129–1148; GenBank deposition statement 292–298.

primary_sources.locator: DOI 10.4161/cc.6.1.3665; original Methods, CYFIP2-expression and leptomycin-B Results, Discussion of earlier Saller experiments.
primary_sources.read_scope: Complete cached abstract; author-uploaded original Methods lines 293–739, selected Results 880–1090 and Discussion 1091–1407, Figure 4/5 caption text.
primary_sources.limits: No pixels or full historical clone sequence established.
primary_sources.conclusion: Human CYFIP2 expression in DLD1 induces multiple apoptosis readouts; low-expression tagged protein is cytoplasmic and LMB produces partial nuclear accumulation. Discussion reports earlier 1999 negative ectopic assay; CYFIP2 knockdown did not abolish p53-mediated apoptosis.

primary_sources.locator: DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0091465; HeLa FMRP-co-IP/RNase Results and immunoprecipitation Methods.

primary_sources.locator: DOI 10.1038/nature09623; PMC3085272, recombinant WRC structure/activation Results and construct/reconstitution Methods.

primary_sources.limits: Not claimed as an independent owner reread of every consulted original.

primary_sources.locator: DOI 10.1091/mbc.E16-05-0326; Figures1–4 Results, mouse constructs/antibodies, pull-down/co-IP, neuronal culture/internalization/signaling Methods.
primary_sources.read_scope: Original XML selected paragraph indices 4,7,8,9,15,18,22,25,33,44,47,48,49,51,56,59.
primary_sources.limits: Mouse CYFIP2 and neurons; HEK cells are an expression host, not proof of a human protein experiment. No full SI/pixels.
primary_sources.conclusion: Direct mouse CYFIP2 N-terminal fragment/retrolinkin binding; single CYFIP2 knockdown reduces branching, while combined CYFIP1/2 depletion is required for the reported TrkB internalization deficit. Acute signaling tests also use WAVE1/retrolinkin perturbation, not a clean CYFIP2-alone catalytic experiment.

primary_sources.locator: Abstract; DOI 10.1002/ana.25208.
primary_sources.read_scope: Abstract only; the original full text was not recovered. Reports Arg87 substitutions, weakened VCA association and altered actin accumulation; construct and current human-product identities remain unverified.
primary_sources.limits: Original access and assay limits are specified above.
primary_sources.conclusion: Reported WAVE disinhibition model; original Methods unavailable.

primary_sources.locator: Structural modeling Methods; DOI 10.1038/s41431-018-0331-z.
primary_sources.read_scope: Original structural-modeling Methods explicitly replace CYFIP1 in 3P8C/4N78 with modeled CYFIP2. Human variants are directly observed, but predicted interface effects are not measured target kinetics or proof of WRC disassembly.
primary_sources.limits: Original access and assay limits are specified above.
primary_sources.conclusion: Human clinical observations and CYFIP2 model built on CYFIP1 templates; no direct target kinetic assay.

primary_sources.locator: DNA Constructs Methods; Results comparing Rac levels; supplemental Figure S2; DOI 10.3390/cells9061355.
primary_sources.read_scope: Original Methods and Results distinguish a mainly murine CYFIP1 mutant panel from direct mouse CYFIP2-R87C rescue in Figure S2. Enhancement occurs under reduced Rac, not ordinary Rac levels; no direct human-product assay is claimed.
primary_sources.limits: No full-paper or human splice-product equivalence claim. Supplemental Figure S2 pixels were read by the independent original-source consultant; owner selected main-text reads are separately recorded.
primary_sources.conclusion: Direct mouse CYFIP2-R87C rescue supports context-sensitive WRC activation; most other variants were tested in CYFIP1.

primary_sources.locator: Fibroblast cultures, migration and phalloidin Methods; functional Results/Figure 3 caption; DOI 10.1038/s41436-020-01011-x.
primary_sources.read_scope: Original Methods and Results compare six patient fibroblast lines with three controls. Dorsal ruffles are reduced in all six; slower migration is restricted to Tyr108His. Interface explanations are modeled; no isogenic rescue or uniform activation claim.
primary_sources.limits: Original access and assay limits are specified above.
primary_sources.conclusion: Direct human actin-remodeling defects with variant-specific migration outcomes, not a uniform gain-of-function readout.

primary_sources.locator: Abstract; DOI 10.1002/ana.26535.
primary_sources.read_scope: Complete abstract only; the original full text was not recovered. R87C knock-in mouse brain has reduced CYFIP2 protein, with increased ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation reported. Exact mechanistic constructs and human-product equivalence remain unverified.
primary_sources.limits: Original access and assay limits are specified above.
primary_sources.conclusion: Mouse protein destabilization qualifies a uniform WRC gain-of-function narrative.

phylogeny.judgment: Actual descent is valid. Self-donor evidence is not circular. The SCAR NOT record conflicts with independent human complex evidence and is posed for curator reconciliation; no RNA-binding/translation activity is manufactured from FMRP association.

followup_scope.external_access: Four externally read original papers 11438699/15048733/17245118/28692454 retain abstract-only repository caches; ambiguous false full_text_unavailable fields omitted.
followup_scope.variant_mechanism: Human clinical observations, modeled interfaces, murine CYFIP2 rescue, human patient-cell phenotypes and mouse degradation evidence are distinguished. Existing one-core scope is enriched; no NEW annotation or uniform variant effect is inferred.
